draw stack exact 为 ancestor transform/clip→node transform→opacity isolation→self content→descendant clip/children→self stroke→opacity composite。
Image always self-clips；Text by overflow；box primitives in own box；free Vector/Group no auto self-clip。
all clips intersect；opacity covers whole subtree 且不改变 bounds。

main cursor 从0按 leading margin→child size→trailing margin，并仅 materialized adjacent 加 gap。
signed negative margins allow cursor retreat/overlap/outset，不 collapse。

overflow 时 free=0，all justify fallback START distribution。

cross HUG 取 all child MarginExtent furthest positive；再 add padding/stroke and min/max。
empty HUG Stack = padding + stroke。

span 中无 AUTO 时允许 overflow。

row/column zero-based；track physical order left-to-right/top-to-bottom。

no-contribution AUTO=0；HUG size=explicit tracks+adjacent gaps+padding+inward stroke；zero track still keeps both declared gaps。

empty Grid 保留 explicit tracks/gaps size。

over capacity fail directly，不 approximate。
